An audit pass after 1.2.20, on both themes.

- **Monokuma Legacy: the clock is a clock again.** Switching themes without a reload left the Stained Glass ticker (the state's name, six times over) inside the clock as plain text, because its styling belongs to the theme. The ticker is hidden outside the theme, and a theme switch redraws the clock at once.
- **The settings button under both themes.** The bottom-right launcher wears the gear and opens the Look window (volumes, theme, glass effects, interface scale) under Monokuma Legacy too: a player has no other door to the theme switch. The GM's Sound window is unchanged.
- **Blocks turn less.** The corner blocks rotate 6-8 degrees with their panes instead of up to 12: a clock at 12 degrees was hard to read on a tablet. The audit page says the same now.
- **Checked and unchanged:** the theme switch leaves nothing behind (curtain, glow, ghosts, rotation rules, sidebar padding all clear), the two stylesheets parse, every module script passes a syntax check.
